en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an old stone building with thick plastered walls and a steeply pitched tiled roof, likely part of a small castle or fortified manor. The structure has small rectangular windows with bars and an irregular, slightly rounded corner tower. In the foreground is a low arched stone bridge over a narrow stream, with leafless trees and simple wooden railings surrounding the approach to the building. The image has a white border and slight wear along the edges, consistent with early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed captions or handwriting appear on the front.
